eyebrow.zh: 预算 · 刹车 · 对账

headline.zh:
你的 AI 账单
终于有了刹车
headline.en:
Your AI bill
finally has a brake

sub.zh: CFO 把全公司的 AI 账单交给你？按团队、按人设硬上限：快到顶自动减速、超额直接拒掉、重要的人优先跑。贵的模型单独设限、月底导出对账表、没花完的额度滚到下个月——给平台 / DevEx 团队的真预算控制器。
sub.en: When the CFO hands you the whole company's AI bill, set hard ceilings per team and per dev: it auto-slows near the line, refuses past it, and lets the important people go first. Cap the expensive models separately, export a month-end reconciliation table, and roll unspent budget forward — a real budget controller for platform / DevEx teams.

title.en: A brake, not just a bill

body.zh: 别的工具月底才送来一张账单——钱已经花完了。tokenctl 在每个请求发出去之前就按预算卡住：快到上限自动排队减速，超过直接拒掉，预算花不出去。
body.en: Other tools hand you a bill at month's end — after the money's already gone. tokenctl checks every request against the budget before it leaves: queues and slows near the ceiling, refuses past it. The budget can't be blown.

body.zh: 不是先到先得的死配额。当关键团队预算吃紧，tokenctl 会主动让掉手头不重要的在飞请求，把额度腾给更要紧的流量——关键发版不会被摸鱼请求拖死。
body.en: Not a static first-come quota. When a critical team runs short, tokenctl yields the unimportant in-flight requests and hands the slack to the urgent traffic — so a critical rollout isn't starved by a trivial one.

title.zh: 所有模型一个钱包，贵的单独设限
title.en: Every model, one wallet — expensive ones capped separately

body.zh: 不用在每个后台分别设上限、分别看账单。tokenctl 把公司用的所有 AI 流量汇成一份预算——一个总数管住所有模型。贵的模型（一次会话就是便宜模型的十倍花销）还能单独设一道上限，一次突击烧不掉整月的额度。
body.en: No need to set separate ceilings in every console or juggle separate bills. tokenctl rolls all your company's AI traffic into one budget — one number governs every model. The expensive models (a single session can cost ten times the cheap ones) can take their own separate cap, so one runaway session can't quietly eat a whole month's headroom.

title.zh: 没花完的额度，滚到下月
title.en: Unspent budget rolls into next month

body.zh: 不用再让团队月底突击烧光预算凑满配额。每个节点都能滚存或留宽限：没花完的余量按你定的比例带进下个窗口当临时加成，先消耗再释放；也能给月初留一段宽限，不在切换的瞬间把流量掐断。
body.en: Stop teams racing to burn through the budget at month-end just to fill the quota. Every node can roll over or grant a grace period: unspent balance rolls into the next window as a transient bump at a ratio you set, consumed first then released; or hold the old ceiling live for a grace period so traffic isn't cut off the instant the window flips.

title.en: One command exports the reconciliation table

body.zh: 财务月底来问每个团队到底花了多少、按模型算多少钱？一条命令按月按团队按模型导出 CSV 或 JSON：用量配上一栏手算可验证的金额估算，直接拿去和供应商账单对账——不用再手动拼数字。
body.en: When finance asks what each team actually spent last month, broken down by model in dollars, one command exports CSV or JSON by month, team, and model: usage paired with a hand-verifiable cost estimate column, ready to reconcile against the provider invoice — no more stitching numbers by hand.

headline.zh: 把公司的 AI 账单管起来
headline.en: Take control of the company AI bill

sub.zh: Apache-2.0 开源，不用搭数据库，也不起第二个进程。一份配置写好预算结构，把现有 agent 入口指过来就开始执行。
sub.en: Apache-2.0 licensed, no database to stand up and no second process to run. One config file describes the budget; point your existing agents at it and enforcement begins.
